name: DisequalityDispersion.half_le_div_cast
typeText:
∀ (n s : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 s →
    LE.le.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 s) n →
      LE.le.{0} (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 ↑s)) ↑(HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} n s)

source.code:
/-- `n / (2s) ≤ ⌊n / s⌋` for `n ≥ 2s`, in the reals. -/
theorem half_le_div_cast (n s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hn : 2 * s ≤ n) :
    (n : ℝ) / (2 * s) ≤ ((n / s : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  have hq : 2 ≤ n / s := by
    rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hs]
    linarith
  have hmod := Nat.mod_lt n hs
  have hdiv := Nat.div_add_mod n s
  have h1 : n ≤ 2 * (n / s) * s := by
    have : n % s < s := hmod
    nlinarith
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  have : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((n / s : ℕ) : ℝ) * s := by exact_mod_cast h1
  linarith
